name: Kira Yoshikage
source:
Yoshikage Kira is the main antagonist of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable, a 33-year-old serial killer who tries to live a completely ordinary life while hiding a dark obsession.
In arakisou, he is the only normal guy among all those weirdos.
